# Cloud Lord

> Infrastructure consultancy — platform engineering, cloud architecture, and AI enablement.

## Pages

- [Home](https://cloud-lord.com/): Consultancy overview — AWS specialization, Terraform, Kubernetes, and company-wide LLM adoption, run independently by Tomislav Ivanović.
- [About](https://cloud-lord.com/#about): Who is behind Cloud Lord and the background behind the practice.
- [Services](https://cloud-lord.com/#services): The engagement offerings — platform engineering, cloud architecture, and AI enablement.
- [Process](https://cloud-lord.com/#process): How a Cloud Lord engagement runs, end to end.
- [Contact](https://cloud-lord.com/#contact): How to get in touch.
- [Blog](https://cloud-lord.com/blog): Essays on self-hosting, agent orchestration, and infrastructure work.
- [From dictation to deploy: how I shipped a Mailcow stack via voice-driven Pulsar Relay plans](https://cloud-lord.com/blog/from-dictation-to-deploy-mailcow): A 2 AM voice dictation became a self-hosted Mailcow instance with encrypted S3 backups via 14 sequential agent components.
- [Pulsar Relay: a 200-line task scheduler I built to keep my agent pool sequential when I needed it](https://cloud-lord.com/blog/pulsar-relay-200-line-scheduler): LangGraph and Temporal are big tools for a small problem — this is the small tool written instead.
- [Building a self-hosted Matomo with consent-gated tracking on Hetzner](https://cloud-lord.com/blog/self-hosted-matomo-hetzner): A Matomo stack with Terraform, Vault, and S3 backups that respects consent without losing half the data to it.
- [Privacy](https://cloud-lord.com/privacy): What data this site collects and how consent is handled.
- [Donate](https://cloud-lord.com/donate): Support the work with a crypto donation.
